Author: Michiru Tsukikage
Name: Tsukimichi
Description:
A quest catalog for every journal type, with completed and available filters and a per-requirement breakdown of what still blocks a quest.
Moonlit treasures collects quests with unique rewards, and per-character snapshots keep the whole account in view.
Local only: no network code.
Punchline: Walk the moon's path: every quest, every requirement, every unique reward.
Changelog:
Moonfall preview

• Moonfall, a preview. A peg game under Menphina's moon, from the Moonfall button on the main window. This preview holds the first ten levels; more are on the way.
• Eorzea's own companions. Eleven familiar faces lend their powers when you hit a green peg, shown on their Triple Triad cards.
• Painted boards. Every level is drawn over a night scene, from the Thanalan roads to the twin lanterns of Vesper Bay, using the game's own art from your install.
• Spoiler-safe. Moonfall follows your spoiler shield: places and companions your story hasn't reached stay hidden until you get there.
• Still growing. This is a preview, so levels, scores and balance may change before the full release.
